verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's docs say users register for and log into eSystems online to reach Webfile, and the probe confirms Webfile sits behind an authenticated eSystems session. That is a remote credential sign-in path, but nothing describes its MFA method. Nothing shows the path avoids a mailed PIN, in-person verification or biometric checks either. Missing for 10: documentation of the eSystems MFA method (e.g., TOTP/SMS/email), confirmation that registration needs no mailed PIN or in-person step, and hands-on verification that an authorized human can complete sign-in fully remotely.
